brief_summary: Horizontal bar chart comparing hands-on installation time for four mods. Tape mod, PE foam mod, and the O-ring mod each show a short amber bar labeled as a fixed one-time whole-board cost (5-8 min, ~10 min, ~30 min respectively). The Holee mod shows a much longer bordeaux-highlighted bar with a scale-break mark, labeled as a per-switch cost of 3-5 minutes multiplied across roughly 68 switches on a 65 percent board, totaling an estimated 3-6 hours.
